intro: This page is where I keep general mechanics, reminders, and quick investigation rules. I will keep this updated as the game changes.

bullets: Most ghosts have a base hunt speed around 1.7 m/s.
Many ghosts speed up with line of sight and keep some speed briefly after losing you.
Player walk speed is slightly slower than a typical ghost, so sprinting, breaking line of sight, and hiding matter.
sections.note: Reminder: if the ghost can see you, it will usually get faster. Break line of sight early.
sections.title: Hunts and speed basics

bullets: Sanity affects when hunts can start, depending on difficulty and ghost type.
Ghost events can drain sanity, so repeated events can push you into hunt range quickly.
On higher difficulties, evidence can be limited, so I rely more on behaviour and consistency checks.
sections.title: Sanity notes

bullets: Find the room: listen, check temperatures, watch for early interactions.
Set up evidence tools: writing, DOTS, orbs, spirit box, UV, EMF.
Confirm with behaviour: speed, events, abilities, and hunt patterns.
Only commit to cursed items when I understand the risk.
sections.title: Quick investigation flow

bullets: Find the room quickly, then stop stalling on missing evidence.
Use behaviour tests: hunt speed, line of sight acceleration, special abilities, and roaming.
Use sensors to create 'proof' (motion/sound) when evidence is limited.
Plan a safe loop or a hiding route before you trigger risky actions.
sections.title: Nightmare focus (2 evidence)

bullets: Treat your single evidence as a filter, not a full answer.
Confirm by behaviour under pressure: hunt thresholds, speed, and ability triggers.
Make the map work for you: pick a hiding route, then test safely and consistently.
If the ghost is confusing, slow down and gather more behavioural data before guessing.
